SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_parent p
WHERE (p.inv_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.inv_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
SELECT p.inv_code, p.inv_name, p.version, p.org_name, p.body_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_detail d WHERE d.parent_code = p.inv_code) AS child_count FROM bom_parent p WHERE p.inv_code = #{invCode}

SELECT child_code, child_name, version, material_spec, make_factory, child_qty, child_note, replace_priority, alt_code, alt_name, alt_spec, alt_factory, alt_qty, is_deliver, is_default, main_status, alt_status, main_rhos_status, alt_rhos_status, admit_note FROM bom_detail WHERE parent_code = #{parentCode} ORDER BY child_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom_parent (inv_code, inv_name, version, parent_qty, org_name, body_code, synced_at) VALUES (#{invCode}, #{invName}, #{version}, #{parentQty}, #{orgName}, #{bodyCode}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inv_name = VALUES(inv_name), version = VALUES(version), parent_qty = VALUES(parent_qty), org_name = VALUES(org_name), body_code = VALUES(body_code), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO bom_detail (parent_code, child_code, child_name, version, parent_qty, effective_date, material_spec, make_factory, child_qty, child_note, replace_priority, alt_code, alt_name, alt_spec, alt_factory, alt_qty, is_deliver, is_default, main_status, alt_status, main_rhos_status, alt_rhos_status, admit_note, org_name, body_code, synced_at) VALUES (#{parentCode}, #{childCode}, #{childName}, #{version}, #{parentQty}, #{effectiveDate}, #{materialSpec}, #{makeFactory}, #{childQty}, #{childNote}, #{replacePriority}, #{altCode}, #{altName}, #{altSpec}, #{altFactory}, #{altQty}, #{isDeliver}, #{isDefault}, #{mainStatus}, #{altStatus}, #{mainRhosStatus}, #{altRhosStatus}, #{admitNote}, #{orgName}, #{bodyCode}, NOW())
